📺 The binge

One more episode... 12 episodes of 45 minutes.

How many minutes is that? How many hours? (1 hour = 60 minutes)

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Grid: 10 + 2 by 40 + 5

400 + 80 + 50 + 10 = 540

Step 2

Column: 12 × 5, then 12 × 40

60 + 480 = 540 (same!)

Step 3

Minutes to hours

540

60

= 9 hours

9 hours on the sofa 📺
